policy: Frozen test detector outputs; one-to-one matching reproduces the original 0.6 µm same-cell/channel benchmark. Distances require a complete manual cell matched at IoU>=0.5 and an unambiguous positive manual A/B line. All outliers included. Cell geometry and pixel fingerprints verified against the cached manual measurement benchmark. Shared-signal comparisons use identical manual A identities. Retained-volume subsets use only detections in the scored ROI, not all production detections in unknown regions. The shared full-cell volume result is independent of signal detection. Historically reused test fold remains exploratory.
